ideas.concept: Decoding the 'Crawled - Currently Not Indexed' dilemma for Indian website owners
ideas.target_audience: SaaS companies, e-commerce stores, and growing Indian websites
ideas.why_timely: Google's John Mueller recently reiterated that 'Crawled/Discovered - Currently Not Indexed' status often signals a site quality issue rather than just a crawling queue delay.
ideas.creative_direction: Break down technical search console metrics into practical, easy-to-understand explanations for in-house teams. Focus on how content depth and quality impact crawl prioritization without making guarantees.
ideas.objective: Educate technical decision-makers on diagnosing site indexing bottlenecks and positioning NSP's technical auditing expertise.

ideas.concept: Safeguarding origin servers and Googlebot when migrating to a CDN
ideas.target_audience: Growing and enterprise web development teams in India
ideas.why_timely: Google Search Central published recent technical guidance addressing how to migrate to a Content Delivery Network without overwhelming origin servers or accidentally blocking Googlebot.
ideas.creative_direction: Highlight technical best practices for web architecture upgrades, focusing on maintaining search engine crawl accessibility during infrastructure changes.
ideas.objective: Establish authority in complex enterprise technical SEO and website infrastructure management.

ideas.concept: Navigating Google Ads Customer Journey Insights and Performance Max page feeds
ideas.relevant_service: PPC & Paid Advertising (Google, Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, Programmatic)
ideas.target_audience: Digital marketing managers and performance marketers across India
ideas.why_timely: Google Ads recently introduced reporting updates including the Customer Journey Insights Overview page pilot and clarified Performance Max page feed functionalities.
ideas.creative_direction: Discuss how marketers can utilize updated attribution transparency to understand how campaigns move users across different conversion journey stages.
ideas.objective: Demonstrate up-to-date platform expertise in paid media optimization and funnel transparency.

ideas.concept: Managing global brand lists across regional marketing campaigns
ideas.relevant_service: PPC & Paid Advertising (Google, Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, Programmatic)
ideas.target_audience: E-commerce brands and multi-location businesses managing international or multi-region ad spends
ideas.why_timely: Google Ads updated its brand settings help documentation, emphasizing the use of single, global canonical brands within its brand library rather than disparate regional fragments.
ideas.creative_direction: Provide a practical walkthrough on structuring brand lists correctly within PPC dashboards to ensure accurate ad delivery control.
ideas.objective: Provide actionable account management insights to performance marketers handling multi-market campaigns.
